items.title: Screen
items.description: With the Screens within the Pinela Series, a new dimension of comfort is created. They soften the light, reduce the wind and provide privacy without losing the connection to the outdoors. Perfectly balanced with the architecture of the outdoor space. For those who do not leave comfort to chance. For those who value every detail. When the sun is high, the Screens filter daylight into a pleasant glow. No harsh contrast, but a gentle transition between inside and outside. When evening falls or the wind rises, they subtly enclose the space. Moving silently with intuitive control. The housing integrates seamlessly with the frame. The anthracite coloured fabric radiates calm, both on the inside and the outside. The result: a fully integrated solution for the moments when the sun is welcome. Just slightly softer.

The rotating louvers glide smoothly, creating the right atmosphere at any moment. Open when you want openness. Sheltered when you need protection. With no visible fixings, the design remains clean, calm, and beautifully refined. Thanks to the wide choice of frame and louver colours, the Fiano Louvre blends effortlessly with any architectural style or outdoor space Fiano Louvre. Subtle in appearance. Grand in experience.

items.title: Polycarbonate options
items.description: If you want to buy a veranda, one of your choices is between polycarbonate or glass roofing. Polycarbonate is a sturdy, but flexible material, making it perfect for roofing. Nevertheless, polycarbonate is flexible, bendable and light weight, making installing and cleaning it easy. Polycarbonate, in general a better value for money than glass. Deponti has four types of polycarbonate roofing in its range. But how do you know what suits your situation and wishes best? Below, you'll find an overview of the differences. Most popular with your costumers, opaque polycarbonate roofing is semi-transparent. The sheets have a milky white colour. With opaque roofing, the light is not reduced but it gives it a diffusion, due to which opaque roofing is more heat resistant than transparent roofing. Leaves, sand an dirt are less visible from inside. Clear polycarbonate roofing is transparent, making it perfect if you want a lot of light to get through. Some also say that the clear polycarbonate look is more luxurious than opaque sheets. Downside is that clear polycarbonate sheets are not very heat resistant. And have a tendency to fog from the inside. Ultra clear carbonate has the same characteristics as clear polycarbonate, however, the ultra clear sheets have a more open texture with wider 'channels'. Because of this, ultra clear offers even more transparency and an even higher light permeability. This type of polycarbonate looks most like glass. Downside is however that everything on the roof like leaves and dirt are visible. Solar control sheets are opaque sheets as well, however they have a double extruded layer which protects form infrared solar waves. They provide the right combination between light diffusion and ideal temperature. This right combination keeps light transmission as high as possible while selectively blocking infrared waves from the visible light to get a low solar transmission. The result is having a solar factor as high as possible while the temperature inside is lower.

items.title: Side wall
items.description: You can make the extra created living space under your veranda even more comfortable and homey by choosing one or more side walls. With a side wall, you close the veranda on one or two sides so rain and wind stand no chance. This allows you to enjoy your outdoors well into the fall. Deponti has both polycarbonate side walls and glass side walls in its product range. These can be included in your order and installed on assembly, but you can always order and install them later. Both the polycarbonate and glass walls allow for light to come in. But if you would rather have fully closed side walls, be sure to check out our Grillo fencing system . Our side walls are made of an aluminium frame combined with 16 mm thick polycarbonate, but a glazed system is possible as well. For the frame, you can choose the colours cream white (RAL9001) or Grey texturized (RAL7024). The Deponti side walls can be mounted underneath every veranda brand and type of terrace system whether it’s aluminium uPVC or timber. Details Colours (frame) Cream white (RAL9001) or Grey texturized(RAL7024) Colours (platen) Polycarbonaat(Opal / Clear / Ultra clear/ Solar control) Standard height (mm) 3000 Depth (mm) 2500/3000/3500/4000 You can choose a fixed glass side wall in your veranda. This system consists of a aluminium frame in which the safety glass is installed and hold in place with rubbers and aluminium glazing bars. This system can be fully customized in shape and size during installation. Details Colours Traffic white texturized (RAL9016) / Cream white (RAL9001) / Grey texturized (RAL7024) Dimensions Lengths of 6000 mm including rubbers.

items.title: Side Gable
items.description: A side gable is used to partially close the sides of you veranda when it for instance is next to a fence or wall, these side gables are designed to cover the sloped part between the veranda roof and the top of the side wall. The side gable is made of an aluminium frame and 16mm thick polycarbonate, but a safety glass version is possible as well. For the frame, you can choose from the colours traffic white texturized (RAL9016), cream white (RAL9001) or grey texturized (RAL7024), depending on the colour of your veranda. You can easily add the side gable to your order, but you can also install it later. The side gable can be installed to all types of verandas we have.

items.title: LED spots
items.description: Want to have dinner with family or friends, read a book on the sofa or play a game with the entire family? With ambient outdoor lighting, you can also enjoy your terrace at night. Our dimmable LED spotlights come with remote control; extra comfort! The LED driver has a capacity of 18 Watts and is suitable for 16-23V or 750mA lighting.

specs.Number of lights: 6 or 10 or a multitude of that

items.title: Concrete foundation blocks
items.description: A Deponti terrace canopy can be installed on any existing surface. For extra stability or when a solid foundation is not available, you can also choose concrete foundation blocks; These concrete pre casted blocks can easily be installed under the posts and of course out of sight. No surface is the same, so seek advice of one of our Deponti dealers about what is the best foundation in your (garden) situation.

items.title: Grillo fencing
items.description: The Grillo fencing system provide extra privacy, in style with your veranda. The fence parts can also be installed as sidewall or rear wall in every veranda and as front shielding under a polycarbonate side wall The components are stackable and can be fitted with click profiles. Like a Lego system with the Grillo fencing you can build anything from side gable, full wall, garden fencing and even planters!

items.title: Glass door handles
items.description: Did you expand your veranda with glass sliding doors? If so, you can choose extra door handles, allowing you to open the sliding doors even easier, without stains or finger prints. These door handles can be attached easily to the glass doors. We have adhesive handles and screw-on handles, perfect for our glass doors with precut holes! Details screw-on handle Comes standard when ordering glass panel with hole. Material Stainless Steel Cross-section(mm) 60 Details adhesive handle round These adhesive handles come in a set of two. The self-adhesive handles are fitted with 3M VHB tape allowing you to easily attach the handles to the glass. Material Stainless Steel Cross-section(mm) 50 Details adhesive handle oval These self-adhesive handles come in a set of two. The handles are fitted with 3M VHB tape allowing you to easily attach the handles to the glass. Material Anodised aluminium Dimensions (mm) 73x30

items.title: Glass door followers
items.description: “Followers” make sure that all panels follow the first one automatically, when opening or closing the glass doors. This way, you can easily open or close the entire system. The followers can be mounted in the doors in a flexible way, meaning that you decide where the panels overlap.

items.title: Glass door weather brushes
items.description: As a finishing touch of your glass doors, aluminium profiles with brushes can be mounted to the sides of the glass doors. These protect your terrace even more from the wind and stabilize and support the glass doors when sliding. The brushes can also be installed later as a add-on.

items.title: Heaters
items.description: Choose the extra comfort of a heater. This allows you to enjoy your veranda longer in the spring and fall and enjoy sitting outside even more. Our ‘Quartz Heater’ has a maximum capacity of 1500W and has three settings. Quartz Heating is similar to central heating. It takes a while before the elements starts glowing and the area is immediately heated. This makes the Quartz Heater perfect for a (closed) veranda. In addition, the heater has an overheating protection. Consisting of aluminium casing and a black heating element, the Quartz Heater looks very smooth. A subtle heat sources that does not detract from the design of your veranda!

items.title: Deponti Fiano Steel-look
items.description: You have eye catchers. And then you have eye-catchers. This is the most recent. With the Deponti Fiano-Steel-look glazing bars from Deponti you create the perfect combination between a homely atmosphere and the feeling of being outdoors. The glazing bars are characterized by a combination of sleek design and a spacious character. The beautiful interplay of lines creates a playful incidence of light. In combination with the black look, you add a modern look to your roof or garden room. In no time. A stylish solution The steel-look glazing bars give your glass wall(s) the robust appearance of steel, with the advantages of aluminum material. It is light, durable and will last for years. So you can enjoy the trendy look in your complete garden room every time. You can also tailor the Deponti Fiano Steel look to your preferences. The black glazing bars can easily be placed on both sides of the glass wall via a connecting U-profile. You can a to adapt to our liking, by adding the horizontal rods. For example, you can opt for a distribution of two, three or four compartments. And to top it off, opt for a beautiful screw-in handle. Completely coordinated with the look of the glazing bars. In no time If your garden room already has glass walls, you can add this steel look. The system is suitable for all glass heights and widths. Regardless of the brand. The steel look is flexible and fully customizable. The only requirement is a glass thickness of 10mm. As a result, no adjustments are required on the existing glass wall and this sustainable system can be installed in no time. With the Steel look you can give a particularly stylish touch to your garden room or roof in no time. Tip: Look for a suitable overlap of the glass walls to make the most of the steel-look system.

items.title: Side and Middle Locks
items.description: These locking systems not only look beautiful, but also provide ease of use and security. The Side and Centre locking systems provide a firm lock and give a reassuring feeling of protection. There are two different types of locking systems: A Side Closure and a Middle Closure. With the Side locks, two profiles are fitted to the post and/or wall and one lock profile to the glass panel. The Centre Lock has an additional lock profile allowing two glass panels to be linked together.

items.title: Lumassina LED strips
items.description: Discover the brand-new Lumassina LED strips. An elegant lighting solution that seamlessly blends day into night. These strips are a beautiful alternative to classic LED spotlights. They provide any canopy with a modern twist and allow consumers to enjoy fine lighting.
